Committed selection changes serialize through AsyncLock; revision advances only after selection persistence succeeds.

Account catalog requests capture selection revision before entering the global operation queue and refuse when selection changes before or while resolving the backend. Once bound, all read/write/cleanup activity remains in that backend.
Credential values are snapshotted synchronously before save operations queue.
Default Mail dialogs listen for app-wide backend changes, invalidate old results, clear disconnected account settings and Forget targets, and reload the current catalog.
A setting change during connection prevents automatic credential save/forget into the later store. Explicit Retry remains available for remembered credentials.
The opt-out load/Forget sequence checks the same dialog revision before issuing Forget, so an old account cannot be deleted from the newly selected backend.

The settings modal prevents barrier/back/Cancel dismissal during Apply; inputs are snapshotted and disabled. External selection changes observed while the local modal is open trigger reload on either completion or cancellation.
